blocks.x: Retire the legacy tax — strangler-pattern modernization with measurable unit economics.

Legacy modernization fails when it is a rewrite project; it succeeds when it is a strangler-pattern program with business metrics. We decompose monoliths along domain seams (event-storming first), route traffic incrementally, and retire components on a schedule the business can see — each wave priced in reduced maintenance cost, deployment lead time and incident load, not just in technology fashion.

The modernization stack is standard and boring on purpose: containers on Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD with progressive delivery, observability from day one. For mainframe estates we add automated code analysis, data-state replay testing, and parallel-run verification — because regulated workloads must prove equivalence before cutover, not after an apology.
